europe_now.title: UK Implicates Iran in RAF Fairford Incident
europe_now.summary: British authorities have stated that Iran is highly likely to be behind the security incident at RAF Fairford. The development highlights rising security concerns regarding state-sponsored threats within Europe.

sources.headline: UK: Iran 'highly likely' to be behind RAF Fairford incident

europe_now.title: EU Approves Major Sanctions Against Russia
europe_now.summary: The European Union has given formal approval to its largest package of sanctions against Russia since the invasion began. The sweeping measures aim to increase economic pressure on Moscow amid ongoing conflict.

sources.headline: EU approves biggest Russia sanctions package since invasion began

top_stories.title: Cyberattack Disrupts French Supermarket Refrigeration
top_stories.summary: A cyberattack targeted commercial refrigerators across French supermarkets, creating operational challenges for the retail sector. Officials are responding to the digital disruption affecting food storage systems.

sources.headline: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
French supermarkets face food crisis after cyberattack hits refrigerators

top_stories.title: UK and EU Schedule Brexit Reset Summit
top_stories.summary: The United Kingdom and the European Union have officially agreed to hold a high-level Brexit reset summit on November 20. Leaders from both sides plan to discuss future cooperation and bilateral relations.
